            node_name_en: Supply Air Diffuser  
            node_type: Distribution_Node  
            node_subtype: TRM  
            node_category: DST  
            
            function: 送风末端分配  
            medium_in: AIR-SA  
            medium_out: AIR-SA  
            
            multiplicity: multiple  
            
            equipment_parameters:  
              types:  
                square_diffuser:  
                  name: 方形散流器  
                  size: {value: "300×300 - 600×600", unit: mm}  
                  application: 一般房间  
                slot_diffuser:  
                  name: 条缝风口  
                  application: 大空间/走廊  
                swirl_diffuser:  
                  name: 旋流风口  
                  application: 高空间  
                laminar_diffuser:  
                  name: 层流送风口  
                  application: 洁净区域  
              material: 铝合金/钢板喷塑  
              
            location_hint:  
              space_type: 吊顶  
              pattern: 均匀布置  
      
        sink_nodes:  
        
          - node_id: HVAC-AHU_SNK_ROOM  
            node_name: 空调房间  
            node_name_en: Conditioned Space  
            node_type: Sink_Node  
            node_category: SNK  
            
            function: 接收空调送风  
            medium_in: AIR-SA  
            medium_out: CONDITIONED_ENVIRONMENT  
            
            is_boundary_output: true  
            
            equipment_parameters:  
              areas:  
                outpatient_lobby:  
                  name: 门诊大厅  
                  area: {value: 2000, unit: "m²"}  
                  ahu_capacity: {value: 30000, unit: "m³/h"}  
                waiting_area:  
                  name: 候诊区  
                  area: {value: 500, unit: "m²"}  
                  ahu_capacity: {value: 8000, unit: "m³/h"}  
                pharmacy:  
                  name: 药房  
                  area: {value: 300, unit: "m²"}  
                  special: 恒温恒湿  
                radiology:  
                  name: 放射科  
                  area: {value: 400, unit: "m²"}  
                  special: 设备散热  
                laboratory:  
                  name: 检验科  
                  area: {value: 500, unit: "m²"}  
                  special: 通风换气  
                  
            environment_requirements:  
              temperature:  
                summer: {value: "24-26", unit: ℃}  
                winter: {value: "20-24", unit: ℃}  
              humidity: {value: "40-60", unit: "%RH"}  
              fresh_air: {value: "≥30", unit: "m³/h/人"}  
              
            location_hint:  
              space_type: 空调区域  
      
          - node_id: HVAC-AHU_SNK_EXHAUST  
            node_name: 排风出口  
            node_name_en: Exhaust Outlet  
            node_type: Sink_Node  
            node_category: SNK  
            
            function: 排出室内废气  
            medium_in: AIR-EA  
            medium_out: AIR-EA  
            
            is_boundary_output: true  
            
            equipment_parameters:  
              type: 排风百叶/风帽  
              location: 屋顶/外墙  
              
            location_hint:  
              space_type: 室外  
      
      edges:  
      
        air_flow_edges:  
          - edge_id: HVAC-AHU_EDGE_001  
            edge_name: 新风至AHU  
            edge_type: DUC  
            from_node: HVAC-AHU_SRC_OUTDOOR_AIR  
            to_node: HVAC-AHU_DST_AHU  
            direction: unidirectional  
            medium: AIR-OA  
            duct_parameters:  
              material: 镀锌钢板  
              insulation: 保温棉  
              
          - edge_id: HVAC-AHU_EDGE_002  
            edge_name: AHU至VAV  
            edge_type: DUC  
            from_node: HVAC-AHU_DST_AHU  
            to_node: HVAC-AHU_DST_VAV_BOX  
            direction: unidirectional  
            medium: AIR-SA  
            
          - edge_id: HVAC-AHU_EDGE_003  
            edge_name: VAV至送风口  
            edge_type: DUC  
            from_node: HVAC-AHU_DST_VAV_BOX  
            to_node: HVAC-AHU_DST_DIFFUSER  
            direction: unidirectional  
            medium: AIR-SA  
            
          - edge_id: HVAC-AHU_EDGE_004  
            edge_name: 送风口至房间  
            edge_type: AIR  
            from_node: HVAC-AHU_DST_DIFFUSER  
            to_node: HVAC-AHU_SNK_ROOM  
            direction: unidirectional  
            medium: AIR-SA  
      
        water_flow_edges:  
          - edge_id: HVAC-AHU_EDGE_011  
            edge_name: 冷水至AHU  
            edge_type: PIP  
            from_node: HVAC-AHU_SRC_CHW  
            to_node: HVAC-AHU_DST_AHU  
            direction: bidirectional  
            medium: WATER-CHW  
            
          - edge_id: HVAC-AHU_EDGE_012  
            edge_name: 热水至AHU  
            edge_type: PIP  
            from_node: HVAC-AHU_SRC_HW  
            to_node: HVAC-AHU_DST_AHU  
            direction: bidirectional  
            medium: WATER-HW  
      
      typical_paths:  
      
        - path_id: HVAC-AHU_PATH_SUPPLY  
          path_name: 空调送风路径  
          path_type: HVAC  
          description: 从室外到室内的送风路径  
          sequence:  
            - step: 1  
              node: HVAC-AHU_SRC_OUTDOOR_AIR  
              action: 新风进入  
            - step: 2  
              node: HVAC-AHU_DST_HRU  
              action: 热回收预处理（可选）  
            - step: 3  
              node: HVAC-AHU_DST_AHU  
              action: 过滤、冷却/加热、加湿  
            - step: 4  
              node: HVAC-AHU_DST_VAV_BOX  
              action: 风量调节  
            - step: 5  
              node: HVAC-AHU_DST_DIFFUSER  
              action: 送风分配  
            - step: 6  
              node: HVAC-AHU_SNK_ROOM  
              action: 空调效果  
      
      control_logic:  
      
        supply_air_temp_control:  
          name: 送风温度控制  
          description: 控制AHU送风温度  
          
          summer_mode:  
            setpoint: {value: 14, unit: ℃, note: "送风温度"}  
            method: 冷水阀调节  
            cascade: 回风温度→送风温度  
            
          winter_mode:  
            setpoint: {value: 28, unit: ℃}  
            method: 热水阀调节  
            
          reset_logic:  
            based_on: 室外温度/负荷  
            range: {value: "12-18", unit: ℃}  
            
        supply_air_pressure_control:  
          name: 送风静压控制  
          description: VAV系统的静压控制  
          
          setpoint_method: 压力无关型  
          sensor_location: 最不利环路  
          setpoint: {value: 150, unit: Pa}  
          control: 风机变频调速  
          
          reset_logic:  
            based_on: VAV箱开度反馈  
            principle: 至少一个VAV箱开度>90%时维持静压  
            
        economizer_control:  
          name: 新风节能控制  
          description: 过渡季节利用新风免费冷却  
          
          enable_conditions:  
            outdoor_enthalpy: 低于室内焓值  
            outdoor_temp: {value: "12-22", unit: ℃}  
            
          mode:  
            minimum_oa: 最小新风比（正常模式）  
            economizer: 100%新风（节能模式）  
            
          control:  
            damper: 新风阀0-100%  
            interlock: 排风阀联动  
            
        humidity_control:  
          name: 湿度控制  
          description: 加湿/除湿控制  
          
          humidification:  
            type: 干蒸汽加湿  
            setpoint: {value: 40, unit: "%RH"}  
            control: PID调节蒸汽阀  
            
          dehumidification:  
            method: 表冷器除湿  
            reheat: 必要时再热  
            
        schedule_control:  
          name: 时间表控制  
          description: 按作息时间运行  
          
          weekday:  
            start: "06:00"  
            stop: "22:00"  
            night_setback: 最小风量维持  
            
          weekend:  
            reduced_capacity: 50%风量  
            
          pre_cooling:  
            start: 提前30分钟启动  
            purpose: 手术/会议前预冷  
      
      alarm_protection:  
        
        ahu_alarms:  
          - alarm_id: ALM_AHU_FAN_FAULT  
            alarm_name: 风机故障  
            severity: HIGH  
            action: 通知维修  
            
          - alarm_id: ALM_AHU_FILTER_DIRTY  
            alarm_name: 过滤器脏堵  
            severity: LOW  
            trigger: 压差超限  
            action: 安排更换  
            
          - alarm_id: ALM_AHU_FREEZE  
            alarm_name: 防冻报警  
            severity: HIGH  
            trigger: 盘管温度<5℃  
            action: 开启热水阀，停止风机  
            
          - alarm_id: ALM_AHU_SMOKE  
            alarm_name: 风管烟感报警  
            severity: CRITICAL  
            trigger: 风管烟感动作  
            action: 停止AHU，联动消防  
      
      dependencies:  
        
        upstream_dependencies:  
          - dependency_id: DEP_AHU_CHW  
            from_system: HVAC-CHP  
            dependency_type: COOLING  
            criticality: HIGH  
            
          - dependency_id: DEP_AHU_HW  
            from_system: HVAC-CHP  
            dependency_type: HEATING  
            criticality: HIGH  
            
          - dependency_id: DEP_AHU_POWER  
            from_system: ELEC-LV  
            dependency_type: POWER_SUPPLY  
            criticality: HIGH  
            
        downstream_dependencies:  
          - dependency_id: DEP_TO_ROOMS  
            to_system: 各功能房间  
            dependency_type: CONDITIONED_AIR  
            criticality: MEDIUM

## 系统 5.3: HVAC-FCU 风机盘管系统
    
    
    System_Topology:  
      
      identity:  
        system_id: HVAC-FCU  
        system_name: 风机盘管系统  
        system_name_en: Fan Coil Unit System  
        system_category: HVAC

    System_Topology:

          配合新风系统使用，满足室内空气品质要求。  
          病房区域采用四管制系统，可同时供冷供热。

                    - 开关控制  
                smart:

              control_logic:

                heating:  
                  - 室温<设定-0.5℃ → 开热水阀

                fan:

            control_points:

                  point_name: 设定温度  
                  point_type: AI

            location_hint:

              note: 靠近FCU

                noise: {value: "≤35", unit: "dB(A)"}  
                
            location_hint:

          - node_id: HVAC-FCU_SNK_OFFICE

            function: 办公区域空调

            is_boundary_output: true  
            
            equipment_parameters:

                  fcu: 多台FCU或AHU服务

              environment:

      edges:  
      
        water_distribution:

            - step: 3  
              node: HVAC-FCU_DST_WATER_VALVE  
              action: 控制阀门开关  
            - step: 4  
              node: HVAC-FCU_DST_FCU  
              action: 风机运行送风  
            - step: 5  
              node: HVAC-FCU_SNK_WARD  
              action: 室温接近设定值  
      
      control_logic:  
      
        individual_room_control:  
          name: 单房间独立控制  
          description: 每个房间温控器独立控制  
          
          control_sequence:  
            cooling_mode:  
              condition: 室温 > 设定温度 + 死区  
              action:  
                - 开启冷水阀  
                - 根据温差选择风速  
                - 持续监测室温  
              stop_condition: 室温 < 设定温度 - 死区  
              
            heating_mode:  
              condition: 室温 < 设定温度 - 死区  
              action:  
                - 开启热水阀  
                - 根据温差选择风速  
              stop_condition: 室温 > 设定温度 + 死区  
              
            deadband:  
              value: {value: 1, unit: ℃}  
              purpose: 防止频繁启停  
              
        central_override:  
          name: 中央集控覆盖  
          description: BA系统远程控制  
          
          functions:  
            temperature_limit:  
              description: 限制设定温度范围  
              summer: {value: "24-28", unit: ℃}  
              winter: {value: "18-24", unit: ℃}  
              purpose: 节能管理  
              
            schedule_control:  
              description: 按时间表控制  
              occupied: 正常运行  
              unoccupied: 温度放宽/停止  
              
            emergency_stop:  
              description: 紧急停止所有FCU  
              trigger: 火灾报警/水管爆裂  
              action: 关闭所有电动阀  
              
        window_interlock:  
          name: 开窗联锁  
          description: 开窗时停止空调  
          
          trigger: 窗磁传感器检测到开窗  
          action:  
            - 关闭电动阀  
            - 停止风机（可选）  
          recovery: 窗关闭后延时5分钟恢复  
          purpose: 节能+防止冷凝  
          
        condensate_protection:  
          name: 冷凝水保护  
          description: 防止冷凝水盘溢出  
          
          detection: 水位开关  
          action:  
            - 报警  
            - 关闭冷水阀  
            - 继续运行风机排水  
          recovery: 人工清理后复位  
          
        filter_maintenance:  
          name: 过滤器维护提醒  
          description: 基于运行时间的维护提醒  
          
          trigger: 累计运行 > 2000小时  
          action: 维护提醒  
          reset: 清洗/更换后手动复位  
      
      alarm_protection:  
      
        fcu_alarms:  
          - alarm_id: ALM_FCU_DRAIN_OVERFLOW  
            alarm_name: 冷凝水溢出  
            severity: MEDIUM  
            trigger: 水位开关动作  
            action: 关冷水阀，通知维修  
            
          - alarm_id: ALM_FCU_OFFLINE  
            alarm_name: FCU离线  
            severity: LOW  
            trigger: 通讯中断>10分钟  
            action: 检查通讯线路  
            
        system_alarms:  
          - alarm_id: ALM_FCU_LOW_WATER_TEMP  
            alarm_name: 冷冻水温度高  
            severity: MEDIUM  
            trigger: 供水温度>14℃  
            action: 检查冷源  
            
          - alarm_id: ALM_FCU_PIPE_LEAK  
            alarm_name: 水管泄漏  
            severity: HIGH  
            trigger: 楼层用水量异常  
            action: 关闭楼层阀门，检修  
      
      dependencies:  
        
        upstream_dependencies:  
          - dependency_id: DEP_FCU_CHW  
            from_system: HVAC-CHP  
            dependency_type: COOLING  
            criticality: HIGH  
            
          - dependency_id: DEP_FCU_HW  
            from_system: HVAC-CHP  
            dependency_type: HEATING  
            criticality: HIGH  
            
          - dependency_id: DEP_FCU_POWER  
            from_system: ELEC-LV  
            dependency_type: POWER_SUPPLY  
            criticality: MEDIUM  
            
          - dependency_id: DEP_FCU_FA  
            from_system: HVAC-AHU  
            dependency_type: FRESH_AIR  
            criticality: MEDIUM  
            
        downstream_dependencies:  
          - dependency_id: DEP_TO_WARDS  
            to_system: 病房  
            dependency_type: CONDITIONED_AIR  
            criticality: MEDIUM  
            
          - dependency_id: DEP_TO_OFFICES  
            to_system: 办公室  
            dependency_type: CONDITIONED_AIR  
            criticality: LOW

## 系统 5.4: ELEC-EL 电梯系统
    
    
    System_Topology:  
      
      identity:  
        system_id: ELEC-EL  
        system_name: 电梯系统  
        system_name_en: Elevator System  
        system_category: ELEC  
        system_type: 电气-垂直运输  
        priority_level: P2-BUSINESS_CRITICAL  
        
        description: |  
          医院电梯系统，提供人员和物资的垂直运输服务。  
          包括客梯、病床梯、担架梯、货梯、消防电梯等多种类型。  
          系统与门禁、火灾报警、BA系统联动。  
          电梯具有群控功能，优化调度，减少等候时间。  
          医院电梯需考虑感染控制、洁污分流等特殊需求。  
          
        design_basis:  
          elevator_types:  
            passenger:  
              name: 客梯  
              capacity: {value: "1000-1600", unit: kg}  
              speed: {value: "1.5-2.5", unit: "m/s"}  
              application: 门诊、行政  
            bed:  
              name: 病床梯  
              capacity: {value: "1600-2000", unit: kg}  
              car_size: {value: "1400×2400", unit: mm}  
              speed: {value: "1.0-1.5", unit: "m/s"}  
              application: 住院楼  
            stretcher:  
              name: 担架梯  
              capacity: {value: "1350-1600", unit: kg}  
              car_depth: {value: "≥2100", unit: mm}  
              application: 急诊、手术  
            freight:  
              name: 货梯  
              capacity: {value: "2000-3000", unit: kg}  
              speed: {value: "0.5-1.0", unit: "m/s"}  
              application: 物资运输  
            fire:  
              name: 消防电梯  
              capacity: {value: "≥1000", unit: kg}  
              speed: {value: "≥1.0", unit: "m/s"}  
              special: 消防专用，火灾时可用  
              
          traffic_analysis:  
            peak_hour: "08:00-09:00"  
            handling_capacity: {value: "≥12", unit: "%", note: "5分钟处理量"}  
            waiting_time: {value: "<60", unit: s}  
            
        design_standards:  
          - GB 7588-2020 电梯制造与安装安全规范  
          - GB 50763-2012 无障碍设计规范  
          - GB 51039-2014 综合医院建筑设计规范  
          - GB 50016-2014 建筑设计防火规范  
        
        version: 1.0  
        last_updated: 2024  
      
      boundary:  
        inputs:  
          - boundary_id: ELEC-EL_IN_001  
            name: 电力供应  
            from_system: ELEC-LV-MAIN  
            medium: ELEC-LV  
            parameters:  
              voltage: 380V AC  
              note: 三相动力电源

            name: 火灾信号

            name: 门禁控制

        outputs:

            medium: TRANSPORT

            name: 状态反馈

            medium: SIGNAL-BMS

            name: 视频监控

            medium: VIDEO

            control_points:

            location_hint:  
              space_type: 电梯机房/控制室  
      
          - node_id: ELEC-EL_DST_LANDING

                - point_id: LANDING_DOOR_OPEN  
                  point_name: 层门开启  
                  point_type: DI  
            
            location_hint:  
              space_type: 各层电梯厅  
              floors: 所有服务楼层  
      
        sink_nodes:  
        
          - node_id: ELEC-EL_SNK_SERVICE  
            node_name: 电梯运输服务  
            node_name_en: Elevator Transport Service  
            node_type: Sink_Node  
            node_category: SNK  
            
            function: 提供垂直运输  
            medium_in: TRANSPORT  
            medium_out: SERVICE  
            
            is_boundary_output: true  
            
            equipment_parameters:  
              service_areas:  
                outpatient_building:  
                  name: 门诊楼  
                  elevators:  
                    passenger: {value: 4, unit: "台"}  
                    stretcher: {value: 2, unit: "台"}  
                  floors: "B2-6F"  
                inpatient_building:  
                  name: 住院楼  
                  elevators:  
                    bed: {value: 6, unit: "台"}  
                    passenger: {value: 2, unit: "台"}  
                    freight: {value: 2, unit: "台"}  
                  floors: "B1-15F"  
                emergency_building:  
                  name: 急诊楼  
                  elevators:  
                    stretcher: {value: 2, unit: "台"}  
                    passenger: {value: 2, unit: "台"}  
                  floors: "B1-5F"  
                medical_technology:  
                  name: 医技楼  
                  elevators:  
                    bed: {value: 2, unit: "台"}  
                    passenger: {value: 2, unit: "台"}  
                  floors: "B2-4F"  
                  
              service_metrics:  
                waiting_time:  
                  average: {value: "<45", unit: s}  
                  peak: {value: "<90", unit: s}  
                handling_capacity: {value: "≥12", unit: "%/5min"}  
                availability: {value: ">99", unit: "%"}  
                
            location_hint:  
              space_type: 全院  
      
      edges:  
      
        power_edges:  
          - edge_id: ELEC-EL_EDGE_001  
            edge_name: 电源至机房  
            edge_type: CAB  
            from_node: ELEC-EL_SRC_POWER  
            to_node: ELEC-EL_DST_MACHINE_ROOM  
            direction: unidirectional  
            medium: ELEC-LV  
            
        mechanical_edges:  
          - edge_id: ELEC-EL_EDGE_011  
            edge_name: 机房至轿厢  
            edge_type: MECH  
            from_node: ELEC-EL_DST_MACHINE_ROOM  
            to_node: ELEC-EL_DST_CAR  
            direction: unidirectional  
            medium: MECHANICAL_POWER  
            note: 曳引绳/钢带传动  
            
        control_edges:  
          - edge_id: ELEC-EL_EDGE_021  
            edge_name: 群控至轿厢  
            edge_type: SIG  
            from_node: ELEC-EL_DST_CONTROLLER  
            to_node: ELEC-EL_DST_CAR  
            direction: bidirectional  
            medium: SIGNAL-CONTROL  
            
          - edge_id: ELEC-EL_EDGE_022  
            edge_name: 层站至群控  
            edge_type: SIG  
            from_node: ELEC-EL_DST_LANDING  
            to_node: ELEC-EL_DST_CONTROLLER  
            direction: unidirectional  
            medium: SIGNAL-CALL  
      
      typical_paths:  
      
        - path_id: ELEC-EL_PATH_NORMAL  
          path_name: 正常运行路径  
          path_type: TRANS  
          description: 乘客正常乘梯  
          sequence:  
            - step: 1  
              node: ELEC-EL_DST_LANDING  
              action: 乘客按下呼梯按钮  
            - step: 2  
              node: ELEC-EL_DST_CONTROLLER  
              action: 群控系统分配电梯  
            - step: 3  
              node: ELEC-EL_DST_CAR  
              action: 轿厢响应，到达层站  
            - step: 4  
              node: ELEC-EL_DST_LANDING  
              action: 开门，乘客进入  
            - step: 5  
              node: ELEC-EL_DST_CAR  
              action: 乘客按目的楼层  
            - step: 6  
              node: ELEC-EL_DST_CAR  
              action: 轿厢运行至目的层  
            - step: 7  
              action: 开门，乘客离开  
      
        - path_id: ELEC-EL_PATH_FIRE  
          path_name: 消防运行路径  
          path_type: FIRE  
          description: 火灾时电梯迫降  
          sequence:  
            - step: 1  
              node: ELEC-EL_SRC_FIRE_SIGNAL  
              action: 接收火灾确认信号  
            - step: 2  
              node: ELEC-EL_DST_CONTROLLER  
              action: 触发消防模式  
            - step: 3  
              node: ELEC-EL_DST_CAR  
              action: 所有电梯就近停靠  
            - step: 4  
              node: ELEC-EL_DST_CAR  
              action: 开门疏散乘客  
            - step: 5  
              node: ELEC-EL_DST_CAR  
              action: 非消防电梯返回基站停止  
            - step: 6  
              node: ELEC-EL_DST_CAR  
              action: 消防电梯供消防员使用  
      
        - path_id: ELEC-EL_PATH_EMERGENCY  
          path_name: 医疗紧急路径  
          path_type: MED  
          description: 急救患者优先运送  
          sequence:  
            - step: 1  
              node: ELEC-EL_DST_LANDING  
              action: 按下医疗紧急按钮  
            - step: 2  
              node: ELEC-EL_DST_CONTROLLER  
              action: 触发医疗优先模式  
            - step: 3  
              node: ELEC-EL_DST_CAR  
              action: 最近病床梯/担架梯响应  
            - step: 4  
              node: ELEC-EL_DST_CAR  
              action: 直达呼叫层（不停靠其他层）  
            - step: 5  
              action: 优先运送患者  
      
      control_logic:  
      
        fire_mode:  
          name: 消防模式  
          description: 火灾时电梯控制  
          
          trigger:  
            - FIRE-FAS火灾确认信号  
            - 消防控制室手动触发  
            
          response:  
            non_fire_elevators:  
              step_1: 取消所有呼叫  
              step_2: 就近楼层停靠  
              step_3: 开门疏散乘客  
              step_4: 返回基站（通常为首层）  
              step_5: 关门停止运行  
              step_6: 切断电源（手动）  
              
            fire_elevator:  
              step_1: 进入消防专用模式  
              step_2: 仅响应轿内消防按钮  
              step_3: 由消防员控制运行  
              
          interlock:  
            - 不响应普通呼叫  
            - 不停靠着火层  
            - 可手动控制至任意层  
            
        medical_priority:  
          name: 医疗优先模式  
          description: 急救患者紧急运送  
          
          trigger:  
            - 医疗紧急按钮  
            - 急诊呼叫  
            - 手术室呼叫  
            
          response:  
            - 最近病床梯/担架梯响应  
            - 直接到达呼叫层  
            - 不停靠中间层站  
            - 到达后保持开门  
            
          timeout: {value: 3, unit: min, note: "自动恢复正常"}  
          
        access_control:  
          name: 门禁联动  
          description: 与门禁系统联动控制楼层  
          
          function:  
            floor_restriction:  
              - 刷卡后开放对应楼层  
              - 未授权楼层按钮无效  
            vip_service:  
              - VIP卡优先派梯  
              - 专用楼层直达  
            time_control:  
              - 夜间部分楼层锁定  
              - 周末减少服务楼层  
              
        energy_saving:  
          name: 节能模式  
          description: 低峰期节能运行  
          
          trigger:   
            low_traffic: 连续10分钟无呼叫  
            night_time: "22:00-06:00"  
            
          actions:  
            - 减少运行台数  
            - 待机电梯关闭照明/空调  
            - 电梯停靠在优化楼层  
            
          recovery:  
            trigger: 有呼叫时  
            time: {value: "<30", unit: s}  
            
        trapped_rescue:  
          name: 困人救援  
          description: 电梯困人时的应急处理  
          
          detection:  
            - 乘客按下紧急按钮  
            - 轿厢长时间不动  
            - 通讯呼叫  
            
          response:  
            step_1: 五方对讲确认  
            step_2: 通知监控中心  
            step_3: 派遣救援人员  
            step_4: 启动应急照明和通风  
            step_5: ARD（自动救援装置）运行至最近层开门  
            step_6: 人工解救（如ARD失效）  
            
          record:  
            - 困人时间  
            - 救援响应时间  
            - 原因分析  
      
      alarm_protection:  
      
        elevator_alarms:  
          - alarm_id: ALM_EL_TRAPPED  
            alarm_name: 电梯困人  
            severity: CRITICAL  
            trigger: 紧急按钮/通讯呼叫  
            action: 立即救援  
            response_time: {value: "<30", unit: min}  
            
          - alarm_id: ALM_EL_FAULT  
            alarm_name: 电梯故障  
            severity: HIGH  
            trigger: 控制系统检测故障  
            action: 停止运行，通知维修  
            
          - alarm_id: ALM_EL_OVERLOAD  
            alarm_name: 超载报警  
            severity: MEDIUM  
            trigger: 载重>额定110%  
            action: 蜂鸣提示，不关门  
            
          - alarm_id: ALM_EL_DOOR_FAULT  
            alarm_name: 门故障  
            severity: MEDIUM  
            trigger: 开关门超时  
            action: 报警，检修  
            
        system_alarms:  
          - alarm_id: ALM_EL_POWER_FAIL  
            alarm_name: 电源故障  
            severity: HIGH  
            trigger: 主电源失电  
            action: 切换应急电源  
            
          - alarm_id: ALM_EL_COMM_FAIL  
            alarm_name: 通讯故障  
            severity: MEDIUM  
            trigger: 与监控中心通讯中断  
            action: 本地运行，通知检查  
      
      dependencies:  
        
        upstream_dependencies:  
          - dependency_id: DEP_EL_POWER  
            from_system: ELEC-LV-MAIN  
            dependency_type: POWER_SUPPLY  
            criticality: CRITICAL  
            
          - dependency_id: DEP_EL_EPS  
            from_system: ELEC-EPS  
            dependency_type: EMERGENCY_POWER  
            criticality: HIGH  
            for: 消防电梯/病床梯  
            
          - dependency_id: DEP_EL_FAS  
            from_system: FIRE-FAS  
            dependency_type: FIRE_SIGNAL  
            criticality: CRITICAL  
            description: 火灾联动  
            
          - dependency_id: DEP_EL_SEC  
            from_system: INT-SEC  
            dependency_type: ACCESS_CONTROL  
            criticality: MEDIUM  
            description: 门禁联动  
            
        downstream_dependencies:  
          - dependency_id: DEP_TO_BA  
            to_system: INT-BA  
            dependency_type: MONITORING  
            criticality: MEDIUM  
            description: 运行监控  
            
          - dependency_id: DEP_TO_SEC_VIDEO  
            to_system: INT-SEC  
            dependency_type: VIDEO  
            criticality: MEDIUM  
            description: 轿厢视频监控

### 系统 6.1: PLUMB-RW 雨水排水系统

System_Topology:  
​  
  identity:  
    system_id: PLUMB-RW  
    system_name: 雨水排水系统  
    system_name_en: Rainwater Drainage System  
    system_category: PLUMB  
    system_type: 给排水-雨水  
    priority_level: P3-GENERAL  
    
    description: |  
      医院建筑雨水排水系统，收集屋面、露台、广场等区域雨水并排放。  
      采用重力流排水为主，必要时设置雨水泵站。  
      设置雨水收集回用系统，用于绿化灌溉和道路冲洗。  
      系统设计满足暴雨重现期要求，防止内涝。  
      
    design_basis:  
      rainfall:  
        design_return_period: {value: 50, unit: "年", note: "重要公共建筑"}  
        rainfall_intensity:  
          formula: "q = 167A₁(1+C·lgP)/(t+b)ⁿ"  
          note: 根据当地暴雨强度公式  
        duration: {value: 5, unit: min}  
      roof_area:  
        total: {value: 15000, unit: "m²", note: "典型大型医院"}  
      runoff_coefficient:  
        roof: {value: 0.9}  
        pavement: {value: 0.85}  
        green: {value: 0.15}  
        
    design_standards:  
      - GB 50015-2019 建筑给水排水设计标准  
      - GB 50014-2021 室外排水设计标准  
      - GB 50400-2016 建筑与小区雨水控制及利用工程技术规范  
      - 海绵城市建设技术指南  
    
    version: 1.0

### 系统 6.2: ELEC-LTG 照明系统

System_Topology:  
  
  identity:  
    system_id: ELEC-LTG  
    system_name: 照明系统  
    system_name_en: Lighting System  
    system_category: ELEC  
    system_type: 电气-照明  
    priority_level: P2-BUSINESS_CRITICAL  
    
    description: |  
      医院照明系统，包括一般照明、应急照明、装饰照明等。  
      根据不同医疗功能区域的照明需求进行差异化设计。  
      与智能控制系统集成，实现节能和场景控制。  
      应急照明系统确保疏散和关键区域的持续照明。  
      
    design_basis:  
      illuminance_standards:  
        operating_room:  
          general: {value: 750, unit: lux}  
          surgical_field: {value: "20000-160000", unit: lux}  
        treatment_room: {value: 500, unit: lux}  
        ward: {value: 100, unit: lux}  
        corridor: {value: 100, unit: lux}  
        lobby: {value: 200, unit: lux}  
        office: {value: 300, unit: lux}  
      color_temperature:  
        operating_room: {value: 4000, unit: K}  
        ward: {value: 3000, unit: K}  
        public_area: {value: 4000, unit: K}  
      color_rendering:  
        medical_area: {value: ">90", unit: Ra}  
        general_area: {value: ">80", unit: Ra}  
        
    design_standards:  
      - GB 50034-2013 建筑照明设计标准  
      - GB 51039-2014 综合医院建筑设计规范  
      - GB 17945-2010 消防应急照明和疏散指示系统  
      - GB 50016-2014 建筑设计防火规范  
    
    version: 1.0  
    last_updated: 2024

      schedule:

        "22:00":

        evacuation_signs:  
          action: 疏散指示启动  
          mode: 智能疏散（如有）  
        non_fire_floors:  
          action: 保持正常照明  
          purpose: 避免恐慌

        action: 更换灯具  
        
      - alarm_id: ALM_LTG_CIRCUIT_TRIP

        trigger: 回路断路器跳闸  
        action: 检查短路/过载  
        
      - alarm_id: ALM_LTG_EMERGENCY_FAIL  
        alarm_name: 应急照明故障  
        severity: HIGH  
        trigger: 应急灯自检失败  
        action: 立即检修  
  
  dependencies:  
    
    upstream_dependencies:  
      - dependency_id: DEP_LTG_NORMAL  
        from_system: ELEC-LV  
        dependency_type: POWER_SUPPLY  
        criticality: HIGH  
        
      - dependency_id: DEP_LTG_EMERGENCY  
        from_system: ELEC-EPS  
        dependency_type: EMERGENCY_POWER  
        criticality: CRITICAL  
        
      - dependency_id: DEP_LTG_FAS  
        from_system: FIRE-FAS  
        dependency_type: FIRE_SIGNAL  
        criticality: CRITICAL  
        
      - dependency_id: DEP_LTG_BA  
        from_system: INT-BA  
        dependency_type: CONTROL  
        criticality: MEDIUM

        priority: P1  
      - id: ELEC-LV  
        name: 低压配电系统  
        priority: P1  
      - id: ELEC-EPS  
        name: 应急电源系统  
        priority: P1  
      - id: ELEC-UPS  
        name: 不间断电源系统  
        priority: P1  
      - id: ELEC-EL  
        name: 电梯系统  
        priority: P2  
      - id: ELEC-LTG  
        name: 照明系统  
        priority: P2  
        
    hvac_systems:  
      - id: HVAC-CHP  
        name: 冷热源系统  
        priority: P1  
      - id: HVAC-AHU  
        name: 空调机组系统  
        priority: P2  
      - id: HVAC-FCU  
        name: 风机盘管系统  
        priority: P3  
        
    plumbing_systems:  
      - id: PLUMB-DWS  
        name: 生活给水系统  
        priority: P2  
      - id: PLUMB-HWS  
        name: 生活热水系统  
        priority: P3  
      - id: PLUMB-SAN  
        name: 污废水系统  
        priority: P2  
      - id: PLUMB-RW  
        name: 雨水排水系统  
        priority: P3  
        
    medical_gas_systems:  
      - id: MGAS-O2  
        name: 医用氧气系统  
        priority: P1  
      - id: MGAS-VAC  
        name: 医用负压系统  
        priority: P1  
      - id: MGAS-AIR  
        name: 医用压缩空气系统  
        priority: P1  
      - id: MGAS-N2O  
        name: 笑气系统  
        priority: P2  
        
    fire_protection_systems:  
      - id: FIRE-FAS  
        name: 火灾自动报警系统  
        priority: P1  
      - id: FIRE-SPS  
        name: 自动喷水灭火系统  
        priority: P1  
      - id: FIRE-EXH  
        name: 防排烟系统  
        priority: P1  
        
    integration_systems:  
      - id: INT-BA  
        name: 楼宇自动化系统  
        priority: P2  
      - id: INT-SEC  
        name: 安防系统  
        priority: P2  
      - id: INT-NUR  
        name: 护理呼叫系统  
        priority: P2  
        
    medical_environment_systems:  
      - id: MED-OR  
        name: 手术室净化系统  
        priority: P1  
      - id: MED-ICU  
        name: ICU净化系统  
        priority: P1  
      - id: MED-LAB  
        name: 检验科通风系统  
        priority: P2  
  
  # ========================================  
  # 电力依赖关系（Power Dependencies）  
  # ========================================  
  power_dependencies:  
    
    primary_power_chain:  
      description: 主电源供应链  
      flow:  
        - from: 市电  
          to: ELEC-HV  
          type: PRIMARY  
        - from: ELEC-HV  
          to: ELEC-LV  
          type: TRANSFORM  
        - from: ELEC-LV  
          to: ALL_SYSTEMS  
          type: DISTRIBUTION  
          
    emergency_power_chain:  
      description: 应急电源供应链  
      flow:  
        - from: ELEC-LV  
          to: ELEC-EPS  
          type: CHARGING  
        - from: ELEC-EPS  
          to: CRITICAL_LOADS  
          type: BACKUP  
          targets:  
            - ELEC-EL（消防电梯）  
            - ELEC-LTG（应急照明）  
            - FIRE-FAS  
            - FIRE-EXH  
            - MGAS-O2  
            - MGAS-VAC  
            - MED-OR  
            - MED-ICU  
            
    ups_power_chain:  
      description: UPS电源供应链  
      flow:  
        - from: ELEC-LV  
          to: ELEC-UPS  
          type: CHARGING  
        - from: ELEC-UPS  
          to: IT_LOADS  
          type: UNINTERRUPTED  
          targets:  
            - INT-BA（控制器）  
            - INT-SEC（服务器）  
            - INT-NUR（主机）  
            - FIRE-FAS（主机）  
            - 手术室设备  
            
  # ========================================  
  # 冷热源依赖关系（Thermal Dependencies）  
  # ========================================  
  thermal_dependencies:  
    
    cooling_chain:  
      description: 冷源供应链  
      flow:  
        - from: HVAC-CHP  
          to: HVAC-AHU  
          type: CHW_SUPPLY  
        - from: HVAC-CHP  
          to: HVAC-FCU  
          type: CHW_SUPPLY  
        - from: HVAC-CHP  
          to: MED-OR  
          type: CHW_SUPPLY  
        - from: HVAC-CHP  
          to: MED-ICU  
          type: CHW_SUPPLY  
        - from: HVAC-CHP  
          to: MED-LAB  
          type: CHW_SUPPLY  
          
    heating_chain:  
      description: 热源供应链  
      flow:  
        - from: HVAC-CHP  
          to: HVAC-AHU  
          type: HW_SUPPLY  
        - from: HVAC-CHP  
          to: HVAC-FCU  
          type: HW_SUPPLY  
        - from: HVAC-CHP  
          to: PLUMB-HWS  
          type: STEAM/HW_SUPPLY  
          
    air_conditioning_chain:  
      description: 空调供应链  
      flow:  
        - from: HVAC-AHU  
          to: MED-OR  
          type: CONDITIONED_AIR  
        - from: HVAC-AHU  
          to: MED-ICU  
          type: CONDITIONED_AIR  
        - from: HVAC-AHU  
          to: MED-LAB  
          type: CONDITIONED_AIR  
        - from: HVAC-FCU  
          to: WARDS  
          type: CONDITIONED_AIR  
          
  # ========================================  
  # 消防联动关系（Fire Protection Interlocks）  
  # ========================================  
  fire_interlocks:  
    
    fas_master:  
      description: FAS作为消防主控系统  
      sends_to:  
        - target: ELEC-EL  
          signal: FIRE_CONFIRM  
          action: 电梯迫降/消防模式  
        - target: FIRE-SPS  
          signal: FIRE_CONFIRM  
          action: 喷淋泵启动  
        - target: FIRE-EXH  
          signal: FIRE_CONFIRM  
          action: 排烟系统启动  
        - target: HVAC-AHU  
          signal: FIRE_CONFIRM  
          action: 空调停止/新风关闭  
        - target: HVAC-FCU  
          signal: FIRE_CONFIRM  
          action: 着火层FCU停止  
        - target: ELEC-LTG  
          signal: FIRE_CONFIRM  
          action: 应急照明启动  
        - target: INT-BA  
          signal: FIRE_CONFIRM  
          action: 广播疏散/状态显示  
        - target: INT-SEC  
          signal: FIRE_CONFIRM  
          action: 门禁紧急开启  
          
    fire_floor_isolation:  
      description: 着火楼层隔离  
      actions:  
        - system: HVAC-AHU  
          action: 关闭着火区域AHU  
        - system: HVAC-FCU  
          action: 关闭着火区域水阀  
        - system: HVAC-CHP  
          action: 关闭着火楼层供水阀  
        - system: FIRE-EXH  
          action: 开启着火区域排烟  
          
  # ========================================  
  # 医疗气体依赖关系（Medical Gas Dependencies）  
  # ========================================  
  medical_gas_dependencies:  
    
    primary_users:  
      MED-OR:  
        requires:  
          - MGAS-O2（氧气）  
          - MGAS-VAC（负压）  
          - MGAS-AIR（压缩空气）  
          - MGAS-N2O（笑气）  
      MED-ICU:  
        requires:  
          - MGAS-O2  
          - MGAS-VAC  
          - MGAS-AIR  
      WARDS:  
        requires:  
          - MGAS-O2  
          - MGAS-VAC  
          
    alarm_integration:  
      from: MGAS-ALL  
      to: INT-NUR  
      signals:  
        - 区域报警盘状态  
        - 气源压力异常  
        - 真空度异常  
        
  # ========================================  
  # 楼宇自动化集成（BA Integration）  
  # ========================================  
  ba_integration:  
    
    monitored_systems:  
      mechanical:  
        - HVAC-CHP（完全控制）  
        - HVAC-AHU（完全控制）  
        - HVAC-FCU（监控+温度设定）  
        - MED-OR（监控）  
        - MED-ICU（监控）  
        - MED-LAB（监控）  
      electrical:  
        - ELEC-LV（监控）  
        - ELEC-EPS（监控）  
        - ELEC-UPS（监控）  
        - ELEC-EL（监控）  
        - ELEC-LTG（完全控制）  
      plumbing:  
        - PLUMB-DWS（监控）  
        - PLUMB-HWS（监控+控制）  
        - PLUMB-SAN（监控）  
        - PLUMB-RW（监控）  
      medical_gas:  
        - MGAS-O2（监控）  
        - MGAS-VAC（监控）  
        - MGAS-AIR（监控）  
      fire:  
        - FIRE-FAS（信号接收）  
        - FIRE-SPS（监控）  
        - FIRE-EXH（监控）  
        
    integration_protocols:  
      primary: BACnet IP  
      secondary:  
        - Modbus TCP  
        - OPC UA  
      legacy:  
        - Modbus RTU  
        - Lonworks  
  
  # ========================================  
  # 依赖关系矩阵  
  # ========================================  
  dependency_matrix:  
    
    format: |  
      行：依赖方（需要...的系统）  
      列：被依赖方（提供...的系统）  
      值：依赖类型和关键程度  
      
    matrix:  
      # ELEC-HV依赖  
      ELEC-HV:  
        市电: {type: PRIMARY, criticality: CRITICAL}  
        
      # ELEC-LV依赖  
      ELEC-LV:  
        ELEC-HV: {type: POWER, criticality: CRITICAL}  
        
      # ELEC-EPS依赖  
      ELEC-EPS:  
        ELEC-LV: {type: CHARGING, criticality: HIGH}  
        
      # ELEC-UPS依赖  
      ELEC-UPS:  
        ELEC-LV: {type: CHARGING, criticality: HIGH}  
        ELEC-EPS: {type: BACKUP, criticality: HIGH}  
        
      # ELEC-EL依赖  
      ELEC-EL:  
        ELEC-LV: {type: POWER, criticality: CRITICAL}  
        ELEC-EPS: {type: BACKUP, criticality: HIGH}  
        FIRE-FAS: {type: INTERLOCK, criticality: CRITICAL}  
        INT-SEC: {type: CONTROL, criticality: MEDIUM}  
        
      # ELEC-LTG依赖  
      ELEC-LTG:  
        ELEC-LV: {type: POWER, criticality: HIGH}  
        ELEC-EPS: {type: BACKUP, criticality: HIGH}  
        FIRE-FAS: {type: INTERLOCK, criticality: CRITICAL}  
        INT-BA: {type: CONTROL, criticality: MEDIUM}  
        
      # HVAC-CHP依赖  
      HVAC-CHP:  
        ELEC-LV: {type: POWER, criticality: CRITICAL}  
        ELEC-EPS: {type: BACKUP, criticality: HIGH}  
        PLUMB-DWS: {type: WATER, criticality: HIGH}  
        INT-BA: {type: CONTROL, criticality: HIGH}  
        FIRE-FAS: {type: INTERLOCK, criticality: HIGH}  
        
      # HVAC-AHU依赖  
      HVAC-AHU:  
        ELEC-LV: {type: POWER, criticality: HIGH}  
        HVAC-CHP: {type: CHW_HW, criticality: HIGH}  
        INT-BA: {type: CONTROL, criticality: HIGH}  
        FIRE-FAS: {type: INTERLOCK, criticality: CRITICAL}  
        
      # HVAC-FCU依赖  
      HVAC-FCU:  
        ELEC-LV: {type: POWER, criticality: MEDIUM}  
        HVAC-CHP: {type: CHW_HW, criticality: HIGH}  
        HVAC-AHU: {type: FRESH_AIR, criticality: MEDIUM}  
        INT-BA: {type: CONTROL, criticality: LOW}  
        
      # MED-OR依赖  
      MED-OR:  
        ELEC-LV: {type: POWER, criticality: CRITICAL}  
        ELEC-EPS: {type: BACKUP, criticality: CRITICAL}  
        ELEC-UPS: {type: BACKUP, criticality: CRITICAL}  
        HVAC-CHP: {type: CHW_HW, criticality: CRITICAL}  
        HVAC-AHU: {type: CONDITIONED_AIR, criticality: CRITICAL}  
        MGAS-O2: {type: MEDICAL_GAS, criticality: CRITICAL}  
        MGAS-VAC: {type: MEDICAL_GAS, criticality: CRITICAL}  
        MGAS-AIR: {type: MEDICAL_GAS, criticality: CRITICAL}  
        MGAS-N2O: {type: MEDICAL_GAS, criticality: HIGH}  
        INT-BA: {type: MONITOR, criticality: MEDIUM}  
        
      # MED-ICU依赖  
      MED-ICU:  
        ELEC-LV: {type: POWER, criticality: CRITICAL}  
        ELEC-EPS: {type: BACKUP, criticality: CRITICAL}  
        ELEC-UPS: {type: BACKUP, criticality: CRITICAL}  
        HVAC-CHP: {type: CHW_HW, criticality: CRITICAL}  
        HVAC-AHU: {type: CONDITIONED_AIR, criticality: CRITICAL}  
        MGAS-O2: {type: MEDICAL_GAS, criticality: CRITICAL}  
        MGAS-VAC: {type: MEDICAL_GAS, criticality: CRITICAL}  
        MGAS-AIR: {type: MEDICAL_GAS, criticality: HIGH}  
        INT-NUR: {type: NURSE_CALL, criticality: CRITICAL}  
        
      # FIRE-FAS依赖  
      FIRE-FAS:  
        ELEC-LV: {type: POWER, criticality: CRITICAL}  
        ELEC-UPS: {type: BACKUP, criticality: CRITICAL}  
        
      # FIRE-SPS依赖  
      FIRE-SPS:  
        ELEC-LV: {type: POWER, criticality: CRITICAL}  
        ELEC-EPS: {type: BACKUP, criticality: CRITICAL}  
        PLUMB-DWS: {type: WATER, criticality: CRITICAL}  
        FIRE-FAS: {type: INTERLOCK, criticality: CRITICAL}  
        
      # FIRE-EXH依赖  
      FIRE-EXH:  
        ELEC-LV: {type: POWER, criticality: CRITICAL}  
        ELEC-EPS: {type: BACKUP, criticality: CRITICAL}  
        FIRE-FAS: {type: INTERLOCK, criticality: CRITICAL}  
        
      # INT-BA依赖  
      INT-BA:  
        ELEC-LV: {type: POWER, criticality: HIGH}  
        ELEC-UPS: {type: BACKUP, criticality: HIGH}  
        FIRE-FAS: {type: INTERLOCK, criticality: HIGH}

---

### 跨系统联动场景汇总

Cross_System_Scenarios:  
​  
  identity:  
    name: 跨系统联动场景汇总  
    description: 涉及多个系统协同的典型运行场景  
    version: 1.0  
    last_updated: 2024  
​  
  scenarios:  
​  
    # ========================================  
    # 场景1：火灾应急响应  
    # ========================================  
    - scenario_id: SCN_FIRE_EMERGENCY  
      scenario_name: 火灾应急响应  
      trigger: 火灾报警确认  
      priority: CRITICAL  
      
      participating_systems:  
        - FIRE-FAS（主控）  
        - FIRE-SPS  
        - FIRE-EXH  
        - ELEC-EL  
        - ELEC-LTG  
        - HVAC-AHU  
        - HVAC-FCU  
        - HVAC-CHP  
        - INT-BA  
        - INT-SEC  
        
      sequence:  
        t_0:  
          event: 火灾探测器动作  
          system: FIRE-FAS  
          
        t_30s:  
          event: 火灾确认  
          system: FIRE-FAS  
          action: 发出联动信号  
          
        t_32s:  
          event: 电梯迫降  
          system: ELEC-EL  
          action: 就近停靠，返回基站  
          
        t_35s:  
          event: 排烟启动  
          system: FIRE-EXH  
          action: 开启排烟阀和排烟风机  
          
        t_35s:  
          event: 加压送风  
          system: FIRE-EXH  
          action: 开启楼梯间加压风机  
          
        t_40s:  
          event: 空调停止  
          system: HVAC-AHU  
          action: 关闭着火区域AHU  
          
        t_40s:  
          event: FCU关闭  
          system: HVAC-FCU  
          action: 关闭着火楼层水阀  
          
        t_45s:  
          event: 应急照明  
          system: ELEC-LTG  
          action: 所有应急灯点亮  
          
        t_45s:  
          event: 疏散指示  
          system: ELEC-LTG  
          action: 智能疏散系统启动  
          
        t_50s:  
          event: 喷淋启动  
          system: FIRE-SPS  
          action: 着火区域喷头动作  
          
        t_60s:  
          event: 门禁开启  
          system: INT-SEC  
          action: 所有防火门解锁  
          
        t_60s:  
          event: 广播疏散  
          system: INT-BA  
          action: 消防广播启动  
          
      post_fire_recovery:  
        trigger: 消防确认火灾扑灭  
        sequence:  
          - 消防系统复位  
          - 排烟系统停止  
          - HVAC系统逐步恢复  
          - 电梯恢复正常  
          - 门禁恢复正常  
          
    # ========================================  
    # 场景2：市电中断应急响应  
    # ========================================  
    - scenario_id: SCN_POWER_OUTAGE  
      scenario_name: 市电中断应急响应  
      trigger: 市电失电  
      priority: CRITICAL  
      
      participating_systems:  
        - ELEC-HV  
        - ELEC-LV  
        - ELEC-EPS  
        - ELEC-UPS  
        - ELEC-EL  
        - ELEC-LTG  
        - HVAC-CHP  
        - MED-OR  
        - MED-ICU  
        - MGAS-O2  
        - MGAS-VAC  
        - INT-BA  
        
      sequence:  
        t_0:  
          event: 市电失电  
          system: ELEC-HV  
          detection: 失压保护动作  
          
        t_0~15s:  
          event: UPS接管  
          system: ELEC-UPS  
          action: 无缝切换，IT负载不中断  
          loads:  
            - BA系统控制器  
            - 手术室关键设备  
            - ICU监护设备  
            - 消防主机  
            
        t_10s:  
          event: 发电机启动  
          system: ELEC-EPS  
          action: 柴油发电机自启动  
          
        t_15s:  
          event: 发电机并网  
          system: ELEC-EPS  
          action: ATS切换至发电机  
          
        t_15~30s:  
          event: EPS负载恢复  
          action: 分批恢复EPS负载  
          loads:  
            - 消防电梯  
            - 应急照明  
            - 手术室空调  
            - ICU空调  
            - 医用气体机组  
            
        t_30s:  
          event: 应急照明  
          system: ELEC-LTG  
          action: 应急灯已点亮（EPS供电）  
          
        t_60s:  
          event: 冷热源调整  
          system: HVAC-CHP  
          action:  
            - 关闭非关键冷机  
            - 保留关键区域冷源  
            - 电锅炉停止，切换燃气锅炉  
            
        ongoing:  
          event: 监控管理  
          system: INT-BA  
          action:  
            - 监控发电机运行  
            - 优化负载分配  
            - 记录事件  
            
      power_restoration:  
        trigger: 市电恢复  
        sequence:  
          - 确认市电稳定（5分钟）  
          - ATS切换回市电  
          - 逐步恢复正常负载  
          - 发电机冷却后停止  
          - UPS恢复充电  
          
    # ========================================  
    # 场景3：手术室紧急启用  
    # ========================================  
    - scenario_id: SCN_OR_EMERGENCY_START  
      scenario_name: 手术室紧急启用  
      trigger: 急诊手术请求  
      priority: HIGH  
      
      participating_systems:  
        - MED-OR  
        - HVAC-CHP  
        - HVAC-AHU  
        - MGAS-O2  
        - MGAS-VAC  
        - MGAS-AIR  
        - MGAS-N2O  
        - ELEC-LTG  
        - INT-BA  
        
      sequence:  
        t_0:  
          event: 急诊手术请求  
          system: 临床系统  
          action: 指定手术室  
          
        t_0:  
          event: 启动手术室  
          system: INT-BA  
          action: 触发手术室启动程序  
          
        t_0~5min:  
          event: 空调启动  
          system: MED-OR + HVAC-AHU  
          action:  
            - 启动手术室AHU  
            - 建立正压  
            - 温湿度调节  
            
        t_5min:  
          event: 洁净度达标  
          system: MED-OR  
          verification:  
            - 压差≥5Pa  
            - 换气次数≥20次/h  
            - 温度22±2℃  
            
        t_0~2min:  
          event: 医用气体确认  
          system: MGAS-ALL  
          verification:  
            - O2压力正常  
            - VAC真空度正常  
            - AIR压力正常  
            - N2O压力正常（如需）  
            
        t_0~1min:  
          event: 照明就绪  
          system: ELEC-LTG  
          action:  
            - 无影灯预热  
            - 一般照明100%  
            
        t_5min:  
          event: 手术室就绪  
          system: INT-BA  
          action: 确认就绪，通知手术团队  
          
    # ========================================  
    # 场景4：夏季高峰负荷管理  
    # ========================================  
    - scenario_id: SCN_PEAK_LOAD_SUMMER  
      scenario_name: 夏季高峰负荷管理  
      trigger: 室外温度>35℃ 或 电力负荷>90%  
      priority: MEDIUM  
      
      participating_systems:  
        - HVAC-CHP  
        - HVAC-AHU  
        - HVAC-FCU  
        - ELEC-LV  
        - ELEC-LTG  
        - INT-BA  
        
      sequence:  
        t_0:  
          event: 高峰负荷检测  
          system: INT-BA  
          trigger: 室外>35℃ 或 电力>90%  
          
        t_0:  
          event: 负荷优化启动  
          system: INT-BA  
          action: 触发负荷削减程序  
          
        t_1min:  
          event: 冷源优化  
          system: HVAC-CHP  
          action:  
            - 启动所有冷机（冰蓄冷放冷）  
            - 冷冻水供水温度维持7℃  
            - 冷却塔全速运行  
            
        t_2min:  
          event: 温度设定调整  
          system: HVAC-FCU  
          action:  
            - 非关键区域温度设定+2℃  
            - 关键区域（手术室/ICU）不变  
            
        t_3min:  
          event: 照明负荷削减  
          system: ELEC-LTG  
          action:  
            - 公共区域照明降至80%  
            - 关闭装饰照明  
            - 利用自然光的区域降至60%  
            
        t_5min:  
          event: 非关键设备降载  
          system: INT-BA  
          action:  
            - 电热水器暂停  
            - 非关键电梯减速  
            
        ongoing:  
          event: 持续监控  
          system: INT-BA  
          action:  
            - 监控室温和电力  
            - 根据情况动态调整  
            
      recovery:  
        trigger: 室外<32℃ 或 电力<80%  
        action: 逐步恢复正常设定  
        
    # ========================================  
    # 场景5：负压隔离病房启用  
    # ========================================  
    - scenario_id: SCN_ISOLATION_WARD_ACTIVATE  
      scenario_name: 负压隔离病房启用  
      trigger: 传染病患者入院  
      priority: HIGH  
      
      participating_systems:  
        - HVAC-AHU（隔离区新风机组）  
        - HVAC-FCU（隔离区）  
        - FIRE-EXH（排风）  
        - MGAS-O2  
        - MGAS-VAC  
        - INT-BA  
        - INT-NUR  
        
      sequence:  
        t_0:  
          event: 隔离病房启用请求  
          system: 临床系统  
          
        t_0:  
          event: 启动隔离模式  
          system: INT-BA  
          action: 触发隔离病房启动程序  
          
        t_1min:  
          event: 排风启动  
          system: 隔离区排风系统  
          action:  
            - 启动排风机  
            - 建立负压  
            
        t_2min:  
          event: 新风启动  
          system: HVAC-AHU（隔离区）  
          action:  
            - 启动新风机组  
            - 100%新风，无回风  
            
        t_3min:  
          event: 负压建立  
          system: 隔离病房  
          verification:  
            - 负压≥-5Pa（相对走廊）  
            - 气流从走廊→病房→卫生间→排风  
            
        t_3min:  
          event: FCU调节  
          system: HVAC-FCU  
          action:  
            - 温度设定24℃  
            - 独立控制  
            
        t_5min:  
          event: 医用气体确认  
          system: MGAS-O2, MGAS-VAC  
          verification: 压力正常  
          
        t_5min:  
          event: 护理呼叫就绪  
          system: INT-NUR  
          action: 确认呼叫系统正常  
          
        t_5min:  
          event: 隔离病房就绪  
          system: INT-BA  
          action: 通知临床可收治患者  
​

        DO: Digital Output

# 第七批次：运维与实施深化文档

## 7.1 完整点表数据库（高优先级）

BMS_Point_Database:  
​  
  identity:  
    name: 医院机电系统BMS点表数据库  
    description: 全院监控点位完整数据库，可导出为Excel/SQL格式  
    version: 1.0  
    last_updated: 2024  
    total_points_estimated: 30000  
​  
  # ========================================  
  # 数据库表结构定义  
  # ========================================  
  database_schema:  
    
    tables:  
      
      # 主点表  
      tbl_points:  
        description: 监控点位主表  
        fields:  
          - name: point_id  
            type: VARCHAR(50)  
            primary_key: true  
            description: 点位唯一标识  
            example: "HVAC-CHP_MB_B1_CH01_AI_CHWST"  
            
          - name: point_name_cn  
            type: NVARCHAR(100)  
            description: 中文名称  
            example: "1号冷机冷冻水供水温度"  
            
          - name: point_name_en  
            type: VARCHAR(100)  
            description: 英文名称  
            example: "Chiller-01 CHW Supply Temp"  
            
          - name: system_id  
            type: VARCHAR(20)  
            foreign_key: tbl_systems.system_id  
            description: 所属系统  
            example: "HVAC-CHP"  
            
          - name: subsystem_id  
            type: VARCHAR(30)  
            description: 子系统  
            example: "HVAC-CHP-CHILLER"  
            
          - name: building_code  
            type: VARCHAR(10)  
            description: 建筑编码  
            example: "MB"  
            
          - name: floor_code  
            type: VARCHAR(10)  
            description: 楼层编码  
            example: "B1"  
            
          - name: room_code  
            type: VARCHAR(20)  
            description: 房间编码  
            example: "MECH-01"  
            
          - name: equipment_id  
            type: VARCHAR(30)  
            foreign_key: tbl_equipment.equipment_id  
            description: 设备编号  
            example: "CH-01"  
            
          - name: point_type  
            type: VARCHAR(5)  
            description: 点位类型  
            values: [AI, AO, DI, DO, ACC, CALC]  
            example: "AI"  
            
          - name: data_type  
            type: VARCHAR(20)  
            description: 数据类型  
            values: [REAL, INT, BOOL, ENUM, STRING]  
            example: "REAL"  
            
          - name: unit  
            type: VARCHAR(20)  
            description: 工程单位  
            example: "℃"  
            
          - name: range_min  
            type: DECIMAL(10,2)  
            description: 量程下限  
            example: 0  
            
          - name: range_max  
            type: DECIMAL(10,2)  
            description: 量程上限  
            example: 50  
            
          - name: precision  
            type: INT  
            description: 小数位数  
            example: 1  
            
          - name: default_value  
            type: VARCHAR(50)  
            description: 默认值  
            example: "7.0"  
            
          - name: alarm_enabled  
            type: BOOLEAN  
            description: 是否启用报警  
            example: true  
            
          - name: alarm_high_high  
            type: DECIMAL(10,2)  
            description: 高高报警值  
            example: 15  
            
          - name: alarm_high  
            type: DECIMAL(10,2)  
            description: 高报警值  
            example: 12  
            
          - name: alarm_low  
            type: DECIMAL(10,2)  
            description: 低报警值  
            example: 5  
            
          - name: alarm_low_low  
            type: DECIMAL(10,2)  
            description: 低低报警值  
            example: 3  
            
          - name: alarm_deadband  
            type: DECIMAL(10,2)  
            description: 报警死区  
            example: 0.5  
            
          - name: alarm_delay  
            type: INT  
            description: 报警延时(秒)  
            example: 30  
            
          - name: alarm_priority  
            type: VARCHAR(10)  
            description: 报警优先级  
            values: [CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW, INFO]  
            example: "HIGH"  
            
          - name: trend_enabled  
            type: BOOLEAN  
            description: 是否记录趋势  
            example: true  
            
          - name: trend_interval  
            type: INT  
            description: 趋势记录间隔(秒)  
            example: 60  
            
          - name: controller_id  
            type: VARCHAR(30)  
            foreign_key: tbl_controllers.controller_id  
            description: 控制器编号  
            example: "DDC-CHP-01"  
            
          - name: controller_address  
            type: VARCHAR(50)  
            description: 控制器内地址  
            example: "AI1"  
            
          - name: protocol  
            type: VARCHAR(20)  
            description: 通讯协议  
            values: [BACnet, Modbus, LON, KNX, OPC]  
            example: "BACnet"  
            
          - name: object_type  
            type: VARCHAR(30)  
            description: BACnet对象类型  
            example: "Analog-Input"  
            
          - name: object_instance  
            type: INT  
            description: BACnet对象实例  
            example: 1001  
            
          - name: cov_enabled  
            type: BOOLEAN  
            description: COV订阅  
            example: true  
            
          - name: cov_increment  
            type: DECIMAL(10,2)  
            description: COV增量  
            example: 0.2  
            
          - name: security_level  
            type: VARCHAR(10)  
            description: 安全级别  
            values: [READ, WRITE, ADMIN]  
            example: "READ"  
            
          - name: display_group  
            type: VARCHAR(50)  
            description: 显示分组  
            example: "冷冻站监控"  
            
          - name: graphic_page  
            type: VARCHAR(50)  
            description: 画面页面  
            example: "CHP_CHILLER_01"  
            
          - name: description  
            type: NVARCHAR(500)  
            description: 详细描述  
            
          - name: install_location  
            type: NVARCHAR(200)  
            description: 安装位置描述  
            example: "B1层冷冻机房1号冷机冷冻水出口"  
            
          - name: sensor_type  
            type: VARCHAR(50)  
            description: 传感器类型  
            example: "Pt100"  
            
          - name: signal_type  
            type: VARCHAR(20)

          - name: is_virtual

          - name: calculation_formula

  # ========================================  
  # HVAC-CHP 冷热源系统点表（示例）  
  # ========================================  
  HVAC_CHP_Points:  
    
    system_info:  
      system_id: HVAC-CHP  
      system_name: 冷热源系统  
      total_points: 1200  
      
    subsystems:  
      
      # ------ 冷水机组 ------  
      HVAC-CHP-CHILLER:  
        name: 冷水机组  
        equipment_count: 4  
        points_per_unit: 80  
        
        point_template:  
          # 运行状态类  
          - template_id: CH_RUN_STS  
            point_suffix: DI_RUN  
            point_name_cn: "{n}号冷机运行状态"  
            point_type: DI  
            data_type: BOOL  
            values: {0: "停止", 1: "运行"}  
            alarm_enabled: false  
            trend_enabled: true  
            trend_interval: 60  
            
          - template_id: CH_FAULT_STS  
            point_suffix: DI_FLT  
            point_name_cn: "{n}号冷机故障状态"  
            point_type: DI  
            data_type: BOOL  
            values: {0: "正常", 1: "故障"}  
            alarm_enabled: true  
            alarm_priority: HIGH  
            alarm_text: "{n}号冷机故障"  
            
          - template_id: CH_AUTO_STS  
            point_suffix: DI_AUTO  
            point_name_cn: "{n}号冷机自动/手动"  
            point_type: DI  
            data_type: BOOL  
            values: {0: "手动", 1: "自动"}  
            
          # 温度类  
          - template_id: CH_CHWST  
            point_suffix: AI_CHWST  
            point_name_cn: "{n}号冷机冷冻水供水温度"  
            point_type: AI  
            data_type: REAL  
            unit: "℃"  
            range: [0, 30]  
            precision: 1  
            signal_type: "4-20mA"  
            sensor_type: "Pt100"  
            alarm_enabled: true  
            alarm_high: 12  
            alarm_low: 5  
            alarm_priority: HIGH  
            trend_enabled: true  
            trend_interval: 60  
            cov_enabled: true  
            cov_increment: 0.2  
            
          - template_id: CH_CHWRT  
            point_suffix: AI_CHWRT  
            point_name_cn: "{n}号冷机冷冻水回水温度"  
            point_type: AI  
            data_type: REAL  
            unit: "℃"  
            range: [0, 30]  
            precision: 1  
            
          - template_id: CH_CWST  
            point_suffix: AI_CWST  
            point_name_cn: "{n}号冷机冷却水供水温度"  
            point_type: AI  
            data_type: REAL  
            unit: "℃"  
            range: [0, 50]  
            precision: 1  
            
          - template_id: CH_CWRT  
            point_suffix: AI_CWRT  
            point_name_cn: "{n}号冷机冷却水回水温度"  
            point_type: AI  
            data_type: REAL  
            unit: "℃"  
            range: [0, 50]  
            precision: 1  
            
          # 流量类  
          - template_id: CH_CHW_FLOW  
            point_suffix: AI_CHWF  
            point_name_cn: "{n}号冷机冷冻水流量"  
            point_type: AI  
            data_type: REAL  
            unit: "m³/h"
